importantNote: Complete mobile UX optimization with Spotify & Echo Music fluid transitions, auto-hiding dock on search focus, exact 100dvh player sheet, high-priority lyrics z-index, and streamlined mobile track lists.

items: Implemented Spotify-style auto-collapsing floating dock and mini-player during search focus.
Fixed full-screen player modal sizing from calc(100vw/0.92) to exact 100vw/100dvh.
Resolved z-index layering so Synced Lyrics modal renders cleanly above the full-screen player.
Cleaned up mobile track rows in Search and Playlists by hiding crowded three-dots buttons on mobile viewports.
Enhanced Service Worker update manager with dismissal persistence and smooth hot-reloads.
